architecture_override.critical_guard: single-flow is PER TRANSPORT LANE, not per Logical Tunnel lifetime. A Logical Tunnel may own 1..4 independent complete WBD Transport Lanes. Each lane has exactly one public TCP-looking flow from initial FakeTCP SYN through Reality-like bootstrap and later DTLS/FEC payload; no FIN/RST/reconnect/new payload SYN inside that lane. Planned replacement is make-before-break A -> A+B -> B.
architecture_override.multipath: Normal desired=1; Game/weak-network desired=2..4. Lanes have independent transport state but share Logical Tunnel identity/lease and logical SessionID/PacketID race domain. First valid arrival wins; duplicates are suppressed; no cross-lane HOL; FEC remains lane-local.
architecture_override.replacement: Same logical LaneID may have one bounded replacement candidate using private transport slot 5; candidate failure preserves healthy old lane; slot 5 is not a fifth logical lane. Live source executes bounded old+candidate Game target overlap, candidate-only promotion, authority update and old transport retirement.
architecture_override.tcp_like_core: Existing FakeTCP TCP-like ACK/SACK/RTO/recovery and release FEC semantics remain frozen. Payload-idle detection is intentionally above transport at Game application ingress.
